title: Pre Vizsla
subtitle: Power Hungry
text: When Played/On Attack: You may pay the cost of an upgrade attached to another non-Vehicle unit. If you do, take control of that upgrade and attach it to this unit, if able. If it can't attach to this unit, defeat it instead.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Token upgrades are considered upgrades. Pre’s ability can be used to pay 0 and choose a token upgrade.
